what.text: This page follows refugees from Yemen living in Somalia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 13496 Yemeni refugees in Somalia, 23.5% of all refugees from Yemen.
Somalia is the largest host of Yemeni refugees, followed by the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Yemen in every year from 2008 to 2025, at war level in most of them, with Ansarallah, AQAP and the Alliance of Yemeni Tribes among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2016 to 2019 and 2021 to 2025, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Somalia.
These are year-end totals for Somalia only, reported to UNHCR.
